name: RWAVault ERC-4626 withdraw override without allowance spend
summary: RWAVault overrides ERC4626 withdraw and redeem without the caller != owner allowance spend, so anyone can burn any depositor's shares and send the assets to any receiver. Once the vault matured, the attacker called withdraw for eight depositors with its own contract as receiver; a backrunner took the remainder in the next block.
notes: Target is the EIP-1167 clone; it ages from its creation, not from the shared implementation's deployment (0x268b273c…). Phase and withdrawalStartTime are lifecycle gates, not resets.
Loss excludes the pending interest that the vault paid to the eight depositors themselves during the withdraws; USDC is valued at par.
